geography.label: Geography
geography.definition: The natural setting, territorial extent, physical features and environmental conditions of places.
includes: Location, area, topography, geology, climate, natural species and land surveys.

disasters.label: Disasters
disasters.definition: Destructive natural or accidental events, their losses, preparedness and responses.
includes: Earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, floods, famine, storms, fires, disaster losses and relief.
excludes: disease incidence without a disaster frame
preventive public works without a disaster purpose.

agriculture.label: Agriculture
agriculture.definition: Cultivation, animal husbandry and the land, inputs and practices supporting farming.
includes: Crops, cultivated area, farm tenure, livestock, sericulture, irrigation and agricultural improvement.
excludes: Commercial forestry and capture fisheries alone
food manufacturing without a substantive farming subject.

forestry.label: Forestry
forestry.definition: Forest resources, their cultivation, protection, harvesting and primary forest products.
includes: Forest area, standing timber, logging, afforestation, camphor, bamboo, fuelwood and charcoal.
excludes: paper manufacture without forest resources or forestry activity.

fisheries.label: Fisheries
fisheries.definition: Capture and cultivation of aquatic resources and the organisation of their exploitation.
includes: Marine and inland fishing, aquaculture, whaling, seaweed and fishing rights.
excludes: food processing without a substantive fisheries subject.

mining.label: Mining
mining.definition: Mineral resources and their exploration, rights, extraction and primary preparation.
includes: Mineral deposits, mines, quarries, coal, petroleum, ores, salt and mining concessions.
excludes: Metal manufacture without mineral extraction or commodity content

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing
manufacturing.definition: Transforming raw materials into industrial, artisan or processed products.
includes: Factories, industrial output, textiles, metals, machinery, chemicals, processed foods and cottage industries.
excludes: Agricultural harvests and mineral extraction alone

utilities.label: Utilities
utilities.definition: Public and industrial service infrastructure and civil works that supply or improve the built environment.
includes: Electricity, gas, water, sewerage, construction, river works, land reclamation and urban planning.
excludes: disaster losses without infrastructure or service content.

land-area.label: land area
land-area.definition: The extent of a territory or a classified part of its land surface.
includes: Territorial area, boundaries expressed as area, and land-use area totals.
excludes: Population density without substantive area data

physical-geography.label: physical geography
physical-geography.definition: Natural landforms, location, geology, soils, coasts and other physical characteristics of a region.
includes: Mountains, lakes, coastlines, geological formations and soil descriptions.
excludes: mineral output or reserves without geographical description.

weather.label: weather
weather.definition: Atmospheric conditions and their observed or seasonal patterns.
includes: Temperature, rainfall, humidity, sunshine, frost, wind and climate comparisons.
excludes: Damage or relief from a particular storm

flora-and-fauna.label: flora and fauna
flora-and-fauna.definition: Wild plants and animals and their distribution or natural characteristics.
includes: Species inventories, native vegetation, wildlife populations and natural habitats.

earthquakes-and-volcanoes.label: earthquakes and volcanoes
earthquakes-and-volcanoes.definition: Seismic activity and volcanic features, eruptions and associated effects.
includes: Earthquake frequency and intensity, volcanoes, eruptions and earthquake losses.
excludes: geological description with no seismic or volcanic subject.

rivers-and-waterways.label: rivers and waterways
rivers-and-waterways.definition: The physical characteristics, courses and water regimes of rivers and other inland waterways.
includes: River systems, lengths, drainage basins, lakes connected to waterways and seasonal navigability.
excludes: flood prevention works without substantive river description.

land-surveys.label: land surveys
land-surveys.definition: Measurement and mapping of land for geographical, cadastral or administrative knowledge.
includes: Surveyed acreage, cadastral surveying, triangulation and land survey operations.
excludes: Registration of ownership or deeds alone
crop area estimates without survey activity.

floods.label: floods
floods.definition: Inundation events and their incidence, extent, causes or consequences.
includes: River floods, storm surges, flooded districts and inundated acreage.
excludes: Flood prevention infrastructure without an inundation event

famine.label: famine
famine.definition: Severe food scarcity affecting populations and its incidence or consequences.
includes: Famine districts, affected population, starvation and crop failure explicitly linked to famine.
excludes: Ordinary food prices, rationing or nutrition without severe scarcity.

disaster-losses.label: disaster losses
disaster-losses.definition: Deaths, injuries and material or economic damage attributed to disasters.
includes: Destroyed buildings, damaged crops, disaster casualties and estimated losses.

disaster-relief.label: disaster relief
disaster-relief.definition: Aid, rescue, recovery support and public assistance responding to a disaster.
includes: Relief funds, emergency food, shelter, rescue operations and disaster assistance recipients.

fires.label: fires
fires.definition: Uncontrolled fires and their incidence, causes or damage.
includes: Urban and rural fires, burned property, fire causes and conflagration losses.
excludes: Fire brigades or equipment without fire-event statistics

storms-and-typhoons.label: storms and typhoons
storms-and-typhoons.definition: Severe atmospheric storms and their tracks, frequency or impacts.
includes: Typhoons, cyclones, violent storms and their damage.

firefighting.label: firefighting
firefighting.definition: Organisation, personnel, equipment and activity for preventing or extinguishing fires.
includes: Fire brigades, fire engines, hydrants, fire prevention and emergency responses.
excludes: Fire loss statistics without response or prevention activity

arable-land.label: arable land
arable-land.definition: Land available for or used in cultivation, classified by agricultural use.
includes: Cultivated acreage, paddy and dry fields, fallow land and agricultural land utilisation.

land-tenure.label: land tenure
land-tenure.definition: Rights and arrangements under which agricultural land is held, rented or farmed.
includes: Owner and tenant farms, tenancy rents, farm holdings, land ownership and tenancy reform.

crop-production.label: crop production
crop-production.definition: The quantity, value, yield and cultivated extent of crops collectively or across several crop types.
includes: Harvest totals, crop yields, planted areas, forecasts and comparative crop production.
excludes: a single crop when its specific tag suffices.

rice.label: rice
rice.definition: Rice as a crop or commodity, including paddy and upland rice.
includes: Rice cultivation, yields, stocks, prices and trade in rice or paddy.
excludes: Rice milling establishments or milling activity without substantive rice data

cereals.label: cereals
cereals.definition: Grain crops collectively or types without a more specific cereal tag.
includes: Millet, kaoliang or sorghum, maize, oats and mixed-grain production or trade.
excludes: rice, wheat or barley alone when a specific tag suffices.

horticulture.label: horticulture
horticulture.definition: Cultivation and production of fruit, vegetables, flowers and other garden crops.
includes: Orchards, market gardens, fruit and vegetable yields and nursery plants.
excludes: a named crop with a sufficient specific tag

tea.label: tea
tea.definition: Tea cultivation and tea as a processed or traded commodity.
includes: Tea acreage, leaf output, tea preparation, prices and tea exports.
excludes: beverages with no substantive tea content.

industrial-crops.label: industrial crops
industrial-crops.definition: Crops grown principally as raw material for non-food processing, or mixed industrial-crop statistics.
includes: Industrial crop areas and yields, sugar beet and raw materials where no specific crop tag suffices.
excludes: named crops adequately covered by a specific tag.

livestock.label: livestock
livestock.definition: Domesticated farm animals and their husbandry or primary products.
includes: Cattle, horses, sheep, pigs, dairy farming, breeding, milk and livestock trade.
excludes: poultry or eggs alone when the specific tag suffices

sericulture.label: sericulture
sericulture.definition: Rearing silkworms and producing cocoons for silk.
includes: Silkworm eggs, mulberry cultivation for silkworms, cocoons and tussah or wild silk rearing.
excludes: Silk reeling, yarn and fabric manufacture without silkworm rearing or cocoons.

irrigation.label: irrigation
irrigation.definition: Supplying and distributing water to agricultural land.
includes: Irrigated acreage, farm canals, irrigation associations, reservoirs and irrigation charges.
excludes: flood prevention works without agricultural water use.

wheat.label: wheat
wheat.definition: Wheat as a crop or commodity.
includes: Wheat acreage, yields, harvests, prices and trade.
excludes: Flour manufacture without substantive wheat data

soybeans.label: soybeans
soybeans.definition: Soybeans and their primary commodity products, including beans, bean cake and bean oil when the soybean connection is substantive.
includes: Soybean cultivation, harvests, stocks, prices, trade and comparisons of soybean products.
excludes: oil milling without an identified soybean subject.

oilseeds.label: oilseeds
oilseeds.definition: Seeds and nuts grown or traded chiefly as a source of vegetable oil.
includes: Sesame, perilla, rapeseed, groundnuts, castor seed and mixed oilseed statistics.
excludes: soybeans alone when the specific tag suffices.

eggs-and-poultry.label: eggs and poultry
eggs-and-poultry.definition: Domesticated birds, poultry keeping, eggs and their primary products.
includes: Chicken, duck and other poultry numbers, egg production and egg or poultry trade.
excludes: general food processing without poultry content.

farm-inputs.label: farm inputs
farm-inputs.definition: Materials, equipment and other production inputs used in farming.
includes: Farm implements, seed supplies, fertiliser use, animal feed and agricultural input costs.
excludes: Production of machinery or fertilisers without farm use

ginseng.label: ginseng
includes: Ginseng acreage, roots, production, processing and trade.
excludes: pharmaceuticals without an identified ginseng subject.

barley.label: barley
barley.definition: Barley as a crop or commodity.
includes: Barley acreage, harvests, yields, prices and trade.

agricultural-extension.label: agricultural extension
agricultural-extension.definition: Institutions and activities that spread agricultural knowledge or improve farming practice.
includes: Model farms, experiment stations offering agricultural improvement, demonstrations, training and advisory work.
excludes: crop production with no extension activity.

land-improvement.label: land improvement
land-improvement.definition: Works that improve existing agricultural land or its productive condition.
includes: Farm drainage, field consolidation, soil improvement and agricultural land improvement associations.
excludes: irrigation alone when its specific tag suffices

shifting-cultivation.label: shifting cultivation
shifting-cultivation.definition: Farming that rotates cultivation between plots after clearing vegetation and leaving land fallow.
includes: Swidden acreage, slash-and-burn farming, cultivation cycles and regulation of shifting cultivation.
excludes: forest clearing without evidence of shifting cultivation.

sugarcane.label: sugarcane
sugarcane.definition: Sugarcane cultivation and cane as an agricultural commodity.
includes: Cane acreage, yields, harvests and cane deliveries or trade.
excludes: Refined sugar or sugar factories without cane data

pineapples.label: pineapples
pineapples.definition: Pineapple cultivation and pineapple as a commodity.
includes: Pineapple acreage, harvests, fresh fruit and pineapple trade.
excludes: Mixed fruit totals without pineapple detail
canning activity without an identified pineapple subject.

plant-fibres.label: plant fibres
plant-fibres.definition: Plants and raw vegetable fibres used for textiles, cordage and related manufacture.
includes: Hemp, flax, jute, ramie, abaca and their cultivated area, raw fibre output or trade.
excludes: cotton alone when the specific tag suffices

indigo.label: indigo
indigo.definition: Indigo cultivation and natural indigo dye production or commerce.
includes: Indigo acreage, leaves, dye extraction, production and trade.

coconuts.label: coconuts
coconuts.definition: Coconut palms and their whole fruit or other primary agricultural products.
includes: Coconut planting, palm counts, nuts harvested and coconut trade.
excludes: Copra alone when its specific tag suffices

copra.label: copra
copra.definition: Dried coconut kernel produced or traded as a commodity.
includes: Copra output, drying, stocks, prices and trade.
excludes: extracted coconut oil without copra data.

coffee.label: coffee
includes: Coffee acreage, beans, harvests, roasting, prices and trade.
excludes: general beverage totals without coffee detail.

forest-area.label: forest area
forest-area.definition: The extent, distribution and composition of forest land and standing timber.
includes: Forest acreage, forest types, ownership classes and standing timber volume.
excludes: Harvested timber output without forest extent

timber.label: timber
timber.definition: Wood harvested or processed for construction and other material uses.
includes: Logging, lumber output, sawmilling, timber species in commerce, prices and trade.
excludes: fuelwood, charcoal or paper pulp alone.

forest-management.label: forest management
forest-management.definition: Administration, regulation, protection and planned exploitation of forests.
includes: Forest working plans, concessions, forest protection, forestry administration and harvesting control.

afforestation.label: afforestation
includes: Tree planting, reforestation, nurseries supplying forest trees and restored forest acreage.
excludes: erosion works with no tree planting.

camphor.label: camphor
camphor.definition: Camphor trees, natural camphor production and its commerce or control.
includes: Camphor extraction, camphor oil, tree resources, production, trade and monopoly operations.

bamboo-and-rattan.label: bamboo and rattan
bamboo-and-rattan.definition: Bamboo and rattan resources, harvesting and commodities.
includes: Bamboo groves, rattan collection, culms, canes and bamboo or rattan products and trade.
excludes: Other timber or plant fibres without bamboo or rattan detail.

fuelwood-and-charcoal.label: fuelwood and charcoal
fuelwood-and-charcoal.definition: Wood and wood-derived charcoal produced or used as fuel.
includes: Firewood harvesting, charcoal kilns, production, fuel consumption and trade.

fishing.label: fishing
fishing.definition: Capture fisheries and their catches, vessels, workers and operations.
includes: Marine and freshwater fishing, catches by species, fishing boats and fishing households.
excludes: manufactured fish products without capture-fishery data.

aquaculture.label: aquaculture
aquaculture.definition: Cultivating aquatic animals or plants under managed conditions.
includes: Fish ponds, hatcheries, oyster or shellfish culture and aquaculture output.

whaling.label: whaling
whaling.definition: Hunting whales and producing or trading primary whale products.
includes: Whaling vessels, catches, species, whale meat and whale oil.
excludes: industrial oils without an identified whale source.

fishing-rights-and-licences.label: fishing rights and licences
fishing-rights-and-licences.definition: Legal rights, permits and regulation governing access to fisheries.
includes: Fishing concessions, fishing licences, fishing grounds rights and licence fees.
excludes: Catch totals without rights or licensing

seaweed.label: seaweed
seaweed.definition: Seaweed and other harvested or cultivated marine algae as resources or commodities.
includes: Kelp, laver, seaweed culture, collection, output, agar feedstocks and seaweed trade.
excludes: agar manufacture without substantive seaweed data.

mineral-production.label: mineral production
mineral-production.definition: Extraction and initial preparation of minerals, collectively or without a sufficient specific mineral tag.
includes: Mine output, quarries, ore dressing, mine counts and mixed mineral production.
excludes: smelting or finished industrial goods without extraction.

coal.label: coal
coal.definition: Coal and coal-derived coke as mineral or fuel commodities.
includes: Coal mining, collieries, lignite, coal output, coke, consumption, prices and trade.

petroleum.label: petroleum
petroleum.definition: Crude oil, shale oil and refined petroleum products as resources or commodities.
includes: Oil extraction, oil shale workings and distillation, refining, fuel oil and petroleum trade.

gold.label: gold
gold.definition: Gold as a mineral, metal or commodity.
includes: Gold mining, placer deposits, output, bullion and gold trade.
excludes: Currency values merely expressed in gold
gold-standard policy without gold commodity data.

silver.label: silver
silver.definition: Silver as a mineral, metal or commodity.
includes: Silver mining, output, bullion and silver trade.
excludes: Currency or exchange rates merely expressed in silver

copper.label: copper
copper.definition: Copper ores and copper metal as resources or commodities.
includes: Copper mines, output, smelting, copper products and trade.
excludes: Copper currency denominations or coins without commodity data

mineral-reserves.label: mineral reserves
mineral-reserves.definition: Identified mineral deposits, estimated reserves and prospective mineral resources.
includes: Ore deposits, coal reserves, geological estimates of recoverable minerals and resource surveys.

iron-ore.label: iron ore
iron-ore.definition: Iron-bearing ore and its extraction, deposits or commerce.
includes: Iron mines, iron ore output, reserves, grades and trade.
excludes: Pig iron, steel or finished iron goods without ore data.

tin.label: tin
tin.definition: Tin ores and tin metal as resources or commodities.
includes: Tin mines, cassiterite, output, refining and trade.
excludes: Tinplate or canned goods without substantive tin commodity data.

tungsten.label: tungsten
tungsten.definition: Tungsten ores and metal as resources or commodities.
includes: Wolfram, scheelite, tungsten mining, output and trade.
excludes: Alloy steel without substantive tungsten data

antimony.label: antimony
antimony.definition: Antimony ores and metal as resources or commodities.
includes: Stibnite, antimony mining, output, smelting and trade.
excludes: Other nonferrous metals or chemicals without antimony detail.

manganese.label: manganese
manganese.definition: Manganese ores and metal as resources or commodities.
includes: Manganese mining, deposits, ore output and trade.
excludes: Steel alloys without substantive manganese data.

lead-and-zinc.label: lead and zinc
lead-and-zinc.definition: Lead and zinc ores, metals and their primary commodity products.
includes: Lead or zinc mining, output, smelting and trade.
excludes: Other metals without lead or zinc detail
manufactured goods where metal content is incidental.

salt.label: salt
salt.definition: Common salt as an extracted, manufactured or traded commodity.
includes: Salt fields, seawater evaporation, rock salt, output, salt manufacture and trade.
excludes: chemical salts unrelated to common salt.

graphite.label: graphite
graphite.definition: Natural graphite resources, extraction and commerce.
includes: Graphite deposits, mines, output, grades and trade.
excludes: Pencil manufacture without substantive graphite data

mining-rights-and-concessions.label: mining rights and concessions
mining-rights-and-concessions.definition: Legal rights, permits and concessions for mineral exploration or extraction.
includes: Mining licences, mining leases, registered claims, concession acreage and mineral-rights regulation.

phosphate-rock.label: phosphate rock
phosphate-rock.definition: Natural phosphate-bearing rock mined or traded for fertiliser and other uses.
includes: Phosphate deposits, extraction, output, exports and phosphate mining concessions.
excludes: Manufactured phosphate fertilisers without raw phosphate-rock data.

industrial-output.label: industrial output
industrial-output.definition: Manufacturing production, capacity and industrial establishments collectively or without a sufficient specific industry tag.
includes: Factory counts, production value, industrial capacity and output across manufacturing branches.

textiles.label: textiles
textiles.definition: Textile manufacturing and textile products collectively or without a sufficient specific fibre tag.
includes: Spinning, weaving, cloth, yarn, mixed textiles and fabric manufacture or trade.
excludes: a single textile fibre when its specific tag suffices.

silk.label: silk
silk.definition: Silk fibre, reeling, yarn, fabric and their commerce, including tussah silk.
includes: Raw silk output, filatures, silk reeling, silk fabrics and trade.
excludes: Silkworm rearing or cocoon production alone

cotton.label: cotton
cotton.definition: Cotton cultivation, raw cotton, cotton yarn and fabrics and their commerce.
includes: Cotton acreage, harvests, ginning, spinning, weaving and cotton-goods trade.
excludes: Other plant fibres or textiles without cotton detail.

wool.label: wool
wool.definition: Animal wool and its preparation, textile manufacture and commerce.
includes: Wool clips, scouring, woollen yarn, felt, woollen fabrics and wool trade.
excludes: hides or furs without wool detail.

rayon.label: rayon
rayon.definition: Regenerated cellulose fibres and textile products made from them.
includes: Artificial silk, rayon fibre, yarn, fabric output and trade.
excludes: other synthetic fibres without rayon content.

iron-and-steel.label: iron and steel
iron-and-steel.definition: Smelting, refining and manufacture of iron and steel and their products.
includes: Pig iron, steelworks, iron casting, rolled steel and iron or steel trade.
excludes: machinery counts without substantive iron or steel production.

machinery.label: machinery
machinery.definition: Manufacture and commerce of machines, engines, tools and mechanical equipment.
includes: Industrial machinery, machine tools, engines, electrical equipment and vehicle manufacture except ships.
excludes: Machine use without equipment as a subject

shipbuilding.label: shipbuilding
shipbuilding.definition: Construction and repair of ships, boats and marine craft.
includes: Shipyards, dockyards, vessels built, ship repairs and marine construction capacity.
excludes: Vessel traffic or fleet counts without ship construction or repair

chemicals.label: chemicals
chemicals.definition: Chemical manufacture and chemical commodities collectively or without a sufficient specific product tag.
includes: Acids, alkalis, dyestuffs, soap, matches, paints and industrial chemical production or trade.
excludes: A specific chemical adequately covered by its dedicated tag

fertilisers.label: fertilisers
fertilisers.definition: Manufacture, commerce and agricultural use of substances added to improve plant nutrition.
includes: Chemical and organic fertilisers, fertiliser factories, output, imports and farm application.

paper-and-pulp.label: paper and pulp
paper-and-pulp.definition: Paper, paperboard and pulp manufacture and their commerce.
includes: Paper mills, wood pulp, paper output, paper products and trade.

ceramics-and-glass.label: ceramics and glass
ceramics-and-glass.definition: Manufacture and commerce of ceramic, pottery and glass products.
includes: Porcelain, earthenware, pottery, glassworks and glass output or trade.
excludes: clay or silica extraction without finished-product data.

food-processing.label: food processing
food-processing.definition: Manufacturing and preparation of foods collectively or without a sufficient specific product or process tag.
includes: Flour milling, meat or fish processing, dairy manufacture, preserved foods and condiments.
excludes: a specific process or commodity when its dedicated tag suffices.

sugar.label: sugar
sugar.definition: Sugar manufacture, refined or raw sugar and its commerce.
includes: Sugar mills, refining, sugar output, beet sugar and sugar trade.
excludes: Sugarcane cultivation without sugar production or commodity data

alcohol.label: alcohol
alcohol.definition: Alcoholic drinks and industrial alcohol as manufactured or traded products.
includes: Brewing, distilling, wine, beer, spirits, alcohol output and trade.
excludes: Alcohol-related illness or crime without commodity data

tobacco.label: tobacco
tobacco.definition: Tobacco cultivation, leaf preparation, manufactured tobacco and commerce.
includes: Tobacco acreage, leaf yields, cigarettes, cigars, factories, output and trade.
excludes: Smoking prevalence or health effects without tobacco production or commodity data.

cottage-industries.label: cottage industries
cottage-industries.definition: Manufacturing carried out in households or small domestic workshops.
includes: Home weaving, household handicrafts, artisan production and domestic workshop output.

rubber.label: rubber
rubber.definition: Natural or synthetic rubber, including cultivation and latex extraction, and rubber-product manufacture or commerce.
includes: Rubber plantations, latex tapping and extraction, raw rubber, synthetic rubber, tyres, rubber goods and trade.

leather-and-furs.label: leather and furs
leather-and-furs.definition: Hides, skins, leather and furs and their processing or commerce.
includes: Tanning, leather goods, fur dressing, hides output and trade.

cement-and-bricks.label: cement and bricks
cement-and-bricks.definition: Manufacture and commerce of cement, bricks and related basic building materials.
includes: Cement plants, cement output, brickworks, tiles used as building materials and trade.
excludes: quarrying of stone without manufactured building materials.

vegetable-oils.label: vegetable oils
vegetable-oils.definition: Oils extracted from plants and their manufacture or commerce.
includes: Oil milling, bean oil, groundnut oil, coconut oil and solidified vegetable oils.
excludes: a single oil with a sufficient specific tag.

tung-oil.label: tung oil
tung-oil.definition: Oil obtained from tung-tree seeds and its manufacture or commerce.
includes: Tung oil production, extraction, grades, prices and trade.
excludes: Other vegetable oils without tung detail

rice-milling.label: rice milling
rice-milling.definition: The industrial removal of husks and processing of rice grain.
includes: Rice mills, milling capacity, milled rice output and polishing operations.
excludes: Rice cultivation or rice trade without milling as a substantive subject

canning.label: canning
canning.definition: Preserving food in sealed cans or containers by industrial processing.
includes: Fruit, vegetable, meat or fish canneries, canned-food output and capacity.

electricity.label: electricity
electricity.definition: Generation, transmission, distribution and use of electrical power.
includes: Power stations, supply networks, electricity output, sales, consumption and tariffs.
excludes: hydroelectric schemes when their specific tag suffices.

gas.label: gas
gas.definition: Manufactured or distributed gas supplied as a utility or industrial fuel.
includes: Gas works, town gas, gas output, mains, consumers and utility tariffs.
excludes: Petroleum extraction or natural gas reserves without supply activity

water-and-sewerage.label: water and sewerage
water-and-sewerage.definition: Public water supply, drainage, sewage collection and treatment services.
includes: Waterworks, piped water, sewers, purification, customers and water or sewer charges.

construction.label: construction
construction.definition: Building and civil engineering works, their extent, costs and activity.
includes: Buildings erected, public works, construction expenditure, contracts and engineering projects.
excludes: Maintenance budgets with no construction content
a single specific infrastructure service without building activity.

flood-control.label: flood control
flood-control.definition: Works and measures intended to prevent or reduce inundation.
includes: Dikes, levees, flood storage, protective embankments and flood prevention expenditure.

river-conservancy.label: river conservancy
river-conservancy.definition: Engineering, administration and maintenance of river channels and their regimes.
includes: River dredging, channel improvement, bank protection, conservancy boards and expenditure.

land-reclamation.label: land reclamation
land-reclamation.definition: Creating usable land by bringing water-covered, coastal, marsh or previously uncultivated ground into use.
includes: Reclaimed acreage, coastal reclamation, marsh drainage for new land and reclamation works.

hydroelectricity.label: hydroelectricity
hydroelectricity.definition: Generating electrical power from flowing or stored water.
includes: Hydroelectric stations, power dams, capacity, output and hydroelectric development schemes.
excludes: mixed electricity supply without identified hydropower.

erosion-control.label: erosion control
erosion-control.definition: Works or practices intended to prevent loss of soil or degradation of slopes and watersheds.
includes: Sabo works, check dams, slope stabilisation and soil conservation projects.

urban-planning.label: urban planning
urban-planning.definition: Planned development, layout and improvement of towns and cities.
includes: City plans, zoning, street layouts, planned districts, capital construction programmes and municipal improvements.
excludes: individual building construction without planning context.

topics.label: History
topics.definition: Past events and historical change presented as a general account or chronology spanning several substantive subjects.
includes: General historical chronologies and event tables; accounts of successive historical periods and political or social change across subjects.
excludes: A dated series whose substantive subject is a specific sector, such as crop output or railway construction; calendar and era conversions alone.

tags.label: historical chronologies
tags.definition: Tabulated sequences of historical events providing a general account across subjects, arranged by date or period.
includes: Year-and-event tables, chronologies of a region and tables of outstanding events covering several historical subjects.
excludes: A chronology devoted to a single substantive subject adequately described by its specific tag; statistical time series; calendar conversion tables.
